title_en: Over 100 illegal jetties in Kelantan to be demolished
summary_en: TUMPAT: A total of 128 illegal jetty along Sungai Golok, stretching from Pengkalan Kubor in Tumpat to Rantau Panjang in Pasir Mas, will be demolished by local authorities following approval from the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) on Monday.
